text:
Margo: quick design review request — i've reworked the "Connectivity Check" step copy & flow for the Private setup wizard. figma: /files/onprem/connectivity-framing-v1. looking for focused UX + a11y + privacy reads before handoff.
Kehinde: skimmed. main concern: users confuse 'probe' with network changes. reframe language to reassure: 'This check only probes connectivity — it won’t modify your network.'
Ryan: agree. two distinct actions needed: a fast 'Quick check (<20s)' and a deeper 'Full trace (2-3 min)'. show time estimates and an inline note about performance impact.
Margo: proposed hero text: "Verifying outbound access to Redwood (no changes to your network)." subline: "Quick checks catch common firewall/proxy issues. Full traces collect more detail to help debugging." action labels: Quick check / Full trace.
Kehinde: privacy flag: any 'Share with Support' flow must list included fields and default-redact hostnames/IPs. privacy-bot can supply exact redaction rules.
privacy-bot: recommended defaults: analytics = summarized hop counts + error codes; support bundles = hashed hostnames + summarized hops; full IP lists only if user toggles explicit opt-in. show a sample redacted snippet in the confirm modal.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) status indicator must include text and an icon (no color-only); 2) changes announced via role="status" with aria-live="polite"; 3) modal must trap focus and restore on close; 4) ensure error text contrast >= 4.5:1.
Ryan: UX details: show a short human explanation above technical output: "Why we check: ensures model downloads and telemetry can reach Redwood." follow with status chip and then a collapsed 'Technical details' panel with monospace output and Copy button.
Margo: i want the Copy button visible even when collapsed (tiny clipboard icon) so SREs can quickly copy a snippet for support. expand label: "Show raw probe output (for support)".
ci-bot: automated-probe 1829876600 result=BLOCKED target=api.redwood:443 probe=tcp timeout_ms=4500 hops=4
Kehinde: can we show the ops output succinctly: status chip + one-line reason (e.g., 'Blocked — port 443 unreachable') and hide the rest behind 'More details'? non-technical users shouldn't see traces first.
Ryan: interaction idea: micro-progress timeline inline: 'probing → analyzing → summary' so users keep context and don't see a blank spinner. for quick checks show optimistic toasts: 'Quick check usually completes <20s'.
Margo: consent UX: 'Share anonymized diagnostics with Redwood Support' button opens a small modal that lists fields to be included with toggles: 'Include hashed hostnames (recommended)', 'Include summarized hops (required)'. default safe. include a short privacy link and sample redacted blob.
privacy-bot: also include an explicit confirmation line: 'No credentials or auth headers will be included.' helps with trust.
a11y-bot: ensure toggles are keyboard operable and announce their state. confirm button should be descriptive: 'Confirm: share anonymized diagnostics'.
Kehinde: mobile: stack primary + secondary actions vertically; make Copy and Download full width; modal full-screen on small devices.
Ryan: performance note: Quick check should hit a separate endpoint optimized for low-latency sampling and not trigger heavy throttling or billing spikes. add telemetry flag 'quick_check=true'.
ci-bot: note: log 1829876625 quick_check run for QA. result=TIMEOUT hops=5
Margo: acceptance criteria for eng: 1) implement quick vs full probe endpoints; 2) plain-language reason up front, collapsed technical details with monospace + Copy; 3) support-bundle consent modal with sample redacted payload and default redaction; 4) aria-live region + focus management for modal; 5) telemetry defaults to summarized-only and quick checks annotated.
Kehinde: i'll add comments in figma with the sample redacted snippet and modal copy.
Ryan: i'll update the component variants (status chips, timeline, copy affordance) and leave implementation notes.
Margo: thanks team — plan to hand off to eng in tomorrow's sync, staging beta next week. tagging @ryan for final copy polish. :white_check_mark:
